title: Astral Foundations
description: A vanilla-friendly mod that adds a copper equipment tier and three metals mined from fallen meteorites: meteoric iron, void steel, and starfall alloy.
body:
# Astral Foundations

**Astral Foundations** is a vanilla-friendly mod that adds a copper equipment tier and three new
metals mined from meteorite ore. It fills the stretch between iron and diamond with gear that's
actually worth chasing, while keeping the pacing and feel of vanilla progression.

## ⛏️ Copper gear

A full copper set you can craft as soon as you have a few ingots: pickaxe, axe, shovel, hoe, sword,
and the four armor pieces. Want the weathered look? Every piece has an oxidized variant, crafted
from oxidized copper ingots. Those are made from a fully oxidized copper block into nine oxidized copper ingots.

## ☄️ Meteoric iron

Meteorite ore spawns deep underground, with a deepslate version further down. Mine it, smelt the raw
chunks into meteoric ingots, and forge a pickaxe, axe, shovel, or sword. Meteoric tools last longer
than iron and take more punishment, though they won't mine any faster. Craft nine ingots into a meteoric block.

## 🌌 Void steel

The combat metal. Drop a meteoric ingot and an eye of ender on a smithing table to forge void steel,
then turn it into a sword, an axe, or a dagger. It trades durability for raw damage, and the dagger
swings fast for quick, lighter hits.

## 🌠 Starfall alloy

The armor payoff. Combine a meteoric ingot with a diamond on a smithing table for starfall alloy,
which carries an animated ingot texture. Craft the full set: helmet, chestplate, leggings, and boots.

Neither alloy needs a smithing template.

## ✨ Elemental Infusions (2.0)

Take any of your astral-tier tools, weapons, or armor back to the smithing table and imbue it with one
of three elements. Each infusion adds a glowing elemental accent to the item and a light effect with the same stats as the base gear, just a new flavor with a little extra utility:

- **🔥 Infernal** (infuse with blaze powder): weapons set what you hit on fire; armor shrugs off fire
  and lava.
- **❄️ Glacial** (infuse with a snowball): weapons chill foes with Slowness; armor keeps you immune to
  freezing and powder snow.
- **⚡ Tempest** (infuse with a Tempest Shard, dropped by charged creepers): storm-attuned gear.
  Weapons always swing a little faster, and hit with extra knockback during a thunderstorm; armor is
  always immune to lightning and makes you faster while the storm rages. The Tempest Shard itself
  crackles with electric sparks wherever it sits.

Infusions are a sidegrade not a new tier, nothing here is required to progress. Mix and match the
element that fits how you play. No smithing template needed.

## ⚠️ Redistribution

Astral Foundations is only published on Modrinth and CurseForge. Please don't reupload it or
download it from anywhere else. All rights reserved.
